title: Cosmic Rocket Builder
creator: Rainbows
description: Build a rocket from engines, fuel tanks, stages, boosters and magic star crystals, then launch it! Clever builds reach the Moon, Mars, other stars and even other galaxies. Silly builds go POOF!
controls: Tap a part, then tap the grid to build. Tap Launch to fly. On a computer: number keys pick parts, arrow keys and Space build, L launches.
